name: kinetochore localized astrin (SPAG5) binding protein

function.text: KNSTRN encodes small kinetochore-associated protein. Annotated molecular activities include protein homodimerization activity and microtubule plus-end binding. It participates in cell migration and chromosome segregation.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Cutaneous Melanoma. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Cohort-level candidate sequence driver in IntOGen (combined q<0.1; at least 3 mutated samples). Statistical association does not classify an individual allele.
